issued_documents_subject_uq.name: issued_documents_subject_uq
issued_documents_subject_uq.where: subject_id IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by IS NULL

stationery_batches_variant_check.name: stationery_batches_variant_check
stationery_batches_variant_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_batches"."variant" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."variant" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,20}$') and ("fees"."stationery_batches"."valid_efy" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."valid_efy" between 2000 and 2100) and ("fees"."stationery_batches"."unit_cost_santim" is null or "fees"."stationery_batches"."unit_cost_santim" >= 0)

stationery_items_key_check.name: stationery_items_key_check
stationery_items_key_check.value: "fees"."stationery_items"."series" ~ '^[A-Z\u1200-\u135A]{0,6}$' and "fees"."stationery_items"."serial" between 1 and 99999999 and "fees"."stationery_items"."width" between 1 and 8 and "fees"."stationery_items"."item_key" = "fees"."stationery_items"."series" || lpad("fees"."stationery_items"."serial"::text, "fees"."stationery_items"."width", '0')

stationery_items_used_check.name: stationery_items_used_check
stationery_items_used_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_items"."status" = 'used') = ("fees"."stationery_items"."used_for_id" is not null and "fees"."stationery_items"."used_for_table" is not null)

stationery_items_end_check.name: stationery_items_end_check
stationery_items_end_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" is null) = ("fees"."stationery_items"."status" not in ('spoiled', 'void', 'missing')) and ("fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" is null or "fees"."stationery_items"."end_reason" in ('misprinted', 'damaged', 'lost', 'stolen', 'not_found_at_count', 'other'))

stationery_movements_units_check.name: stationery_movements_units_check
stationery_movements_units_check.value: ("fees"."stationery_movements"."movement" in ('allocate', 'recall')) = ("fees"."stationery_movements"."from_unit_id" is not null and "fees"."stationery_movements"."to_unit_id" is not null)

cases_due_idx.name: cases_due_idx
cases_due_idx.where: due_at is not null and closed_at is null

bolos_status_check.name: bolos_status_check
bolos_status_check.value: (status <> 'valid' OR sticker_key IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'temporary' OR temporary_until IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'void' OR void_reason IS NOT NULL)

driver_licences_case_uq.name: driver_licences_case_uq
driver_licences_case_uq.where: case_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'voided'

driver_licences_active_check.name: driver_licences_active_check
driver_licences_active_check.value: status <> 'active' OR (number IS NOT NULL AND issued_on IS NOT NULL AND valid_until IS NOT NULL)

driver_licences_migration_check.name: driver_licences_migration_check
driver_licences_migration_check.value: migration_source IS NULL OR (paper_reference IS NOT NULL AND migration_case_id IS NOT NULL AND migration_verified_by IS NOT NULL AND migration_verified_at IS NOT NULL)

exam_results_scores_check.name: exam_results_scores_check
exam_results_scores_check.value: coalesce(theory, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND coalesce(practical, 0) BETWEEN 0 AND 100

licence_restrictions_period_check.name: licence_restrictions_period_check
licence_restrictions_period_check.value: (kind = 'suspension') = (ends_on IS NOT NULL) AND (ends_on IS NULL OR ends_on >= starts_on) AND starts_on >= decided_on

medical_certificates_recommendation_chec.name: medical_certificates_recommendation_check
medical_certificates_recommendation_chec.value: recommendation is null or recommendation in ('grant', 'grant_with_conditions', 'refuse')

medical_certificates_conditions_check.name: medical_certificates_conditions_check
medical_certificates_conditions_check.value: conditions_ct is null or (recommendation = 'grant_with_conditions' and octet_length(conditions_ct) > 16)

migration_sample_counters_check.name: migration_sample_counters_check
migration_sample_counters_check.value:
share BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND block_size BETWEEN 1 AND 100
                        AND block_position BETWEEN 0 AND block_size AND cardinality(block_picks) <= block_size
                        AND drawn BETWEEN 0 AND records

migration_samples_check.name: migration_samples_check
migration_samples_check.value:
(source = 'back_capture') = (case_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source = 'import') = (import_row_id IS NOT NULL)
                        AND clerk_id <> verifier_id AND share BETWEEN 1 AND 100
                        AND (state = 'rechecked') = (rechecked_by IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (rechecked_by IS NULL) = (rechecked_at IS NULL)
                        AND (rechecked_by IS NULL) = (outcome IS NULL)
                        AND rechecked_by IS DISTINCT FROM clerk_id AND rechecked_by IS DISTINCT FROM verifier_id
                        AND (outcome IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'errors') = (cardinality(error_fields) > 0)
                        AND cardinality(error_fields) <= 40
                        AND coalesce(length(note), 1) BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND (note IS NULL OR state = 'rechecked')

migration_samples_scans_check.name: migration_samples_scans_check
migration_samples_scans_check.value:
(scan_file_id IS NULL) = (cardinality(scan_file_ids) = 0)
                        AND (scan_file_id IS NULL OR scan_file_ids[1] = scan_file_id) AND cardinality(scan_file_ids) <= 20

ownership_transfers_amounts_check.name: ownership_transfers_amounts_check
ownership_transfers_amounts_check.value:
coalesce(purchase_price_santim, 1) > 0 and coalesce(market_value_santim, 1) > 0
                        and coalesce(committee_value_santim, 1) > 0 and coalesce(contract_value_santim, 1) > 0
                        and coalesce(depreciation_percent, 0) between 0 and 100

ownership_transfers_text_check.name: ownership_transfers_text_check
ownership_transfers_text_check.value:
coalesce(length(inspection_note), 1) between 1 and 500 and coalesce(length(valuers), 1) between 1 and 200
                        and coalesce(length(contract_reference), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length(stamp_duty_receipt), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length(tax_registration_reference), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length(court_reference), 1) between 1 and 60

ownership_transfers_result_check.name: ownership_transfers_result_check
ownership_transfers_result_check.value: (buyer_ownership_id is null) = (transferred_on is null) and (transferred_on is null) = (transferred_by is null)

replacements_police_check.name: replacements_police_check
replacements_police_check.value: reason = 'damaged' or (police_report_reference is not null and police_report_on is not null)

replacements_notice_check.name: replacements_notice_check
replacements_notice_check.value: item <> 'libre' or reason = 'damaged' or notice_published_on is not null

vehicle_import_rows_state_check.name: vehicle_import_rows_state_check
vehicle_import_rows_state_check.value:
line >= 2 AND (state IN ('imported', 'already_imported')) = (vehicle_id IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (state <> 'invalid' OR jsonb_array_length(errors) > 0)
                        AND (state = 'invalid' OR jsonb_array_length(errors) = 0)

vehicle_imports_state_check.name: vehicle_imports_state_check
vehicle_imports_state_check.value:
(state = 'failed') = (failure_code IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (state IN ('committing', 'committed')) = (committed_by IS NOT NULL)
                        AND (committed_by IS NULL) = (committed_at IS NULL)
                        AND (committed_by IS NULL) = (commit_unit_id IS NULL)
                        AND (committed_by IS NULL OR committed_by IS DISTINCT FROM created_by)
                        AND jsonb_array_length(scan_file_ids) <= 2000

vehicle_imports_commit_event_check.name: vehicle_imports_commit_event_check
vehicle_imports_commit_event_check.value: commit_event_id IS NULL OR state IN ('committing', 'committed')

plate_assignments_replaced_check.name: plate_assignments_replaced_check
plate_assignments_replaced_check.value: "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."replaced_by_id" is null or ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."until" is not null and "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."replaced_by_id" <> "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."id")

plate_assignments_legacy_check.name: plate_assignments_legacy_check
plate_assignments_legacy_check.value: ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."format" = 'legacy') = ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" is not null) and ("vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" is null or "vehicles"."plate_assignments"."legacy_use_code" in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 35))

plate_movements_units_check.name: plate_movements_units_check
plate_movements_units_check.value: ("vehicles"."plate_movements"."kind" in ('allocate', 'recall', 'hand_over_out', 'hand_over_in')) = ("vehicles"."plate_movements"."from_unit_id" is not null and "vehicles"."plate_movements"."to_unit_id" is not null)

plates_vehicle_check.name: plates_vehicle_check
plates_vehicle_check.value: ("vehicles"."plates"."status" in ('assigned', 'retired') and "vehicles"."plates"."vehicle_id" is not null) or ("vehicles"."plates"."status" in ('in_stock', 'allocated', 'reserved', 'void') and "vehicles"."plates"."vehicle_id" is null) or "vehicles"."plates"."status" = 'lost'

plates_end_check.name: plates_end_check
plates_end_check.value: ("vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" is null) = ("vehicles"."plates"."status" not in ('retired', 'void', 'lost')) and ("vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" is null or "vehicles"."plates"."end_reason" in ('exchanged', 'retired', 'transferred', 'lost', 'stolen', 'damaged', 'misprinted', 'other'))

vehicle_arrivals_words_check.name: vehicle_arrivals_words_check
vehicle_arrivals_words_check.value: length("vehicles"."vehicle_arrivals"."document_number") between 1 and 60 and length("vehicles"."vehicle_arrivals"."document_key") between 1 and 60 and length("vehicles"."vehicle_arrivals"."issuing_region") between 1 and 100 and length("vehicles"."vehicle_arrivals"."issuing_region_key") between 1 and 100 and length("vehicles"."vehicle_arrivals"."issuing_office") between 1 and 200

vehicle_encumbrances_text_check.name: vehicle_encumbrances_text_check
vehicle_encumbrances_text_check.value:
length("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."letter_reference") between 1 and 60 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."note"), 1) between 1 and 500
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_reference"), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_note"), 1) between 1 and 500
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_refusal_reason"), 10) between 10 and 500
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."amount_santim", 1) > 0

vehicle_encumbrances_status_fields_check.name: vehicle_encumbrances_status_fields_check
vehicle_encumbrances_status_fields_check.value:
("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."status" = 'open' and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_reference" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_date" is null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_file_id" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_note" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_by" is null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_at" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_by" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_at" is null)
                        or ("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."status" = 'release_pending' and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_reference" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_date" is not null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_by" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_at" is not null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_by" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_at" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_refusal_reason" is null)
                        or ("vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."status" = 'released' and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_reference" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_date" is not null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_by" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_at" is not null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_by" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_at" is not null
                            and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."released_by" <> "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_requested_by" and "vehicles"."vehicle_encumbrances"."release_refusal_reason" is null)

vehicle_handovers_destination_check.name: vehicle_handovers_destination_check
vehicle_handovers_destination_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_kind" = 'office' and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."to_unit_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_name" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_region" is null) or ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_kind" = 'outside' and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."to_unit_id" is null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_name" is not null and length("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_name") between 1 and 200 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."destination_region"), 1) between 1 and 100)

vehicle_handovers_received_check.name: vehicle_handovers_received_check
vehicle_handovers_received_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."status" in ('received', 'returned')) = ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."in_case_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."received_on" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."received_by" is not null)

vehicle_handovers_cancelled_check.name: vehicle_handovers_cancelled_check
vehicle_handovers_cancelled_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."cancel_case_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."cancelled_on" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicle_handovers"."cancelled_by" is not null)

vehicle_owners_one_holder_check.name: vehicle_owners_one_holder_check
vehicle_owners_one_holder_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicle_owners"."person_id" is not null)::int + ("vehicles"."vehicle_owners"."organisation_id" is not null)::int = 1

vehicles_make_key_check.name: vehicles_make_key_check
vehicles_make_key_check.value: ("vehicles"."vehicles"."chassis_kind" = 'other') = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."make_key" is not null) and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."make_key"), 1) between 1 and 120

vehicles_figures_check.name: vehicles_figures_check
vehicles_figures_check.value:
coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."seats", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."load_capacity_kg", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."gross_weight_kg", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_cc", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."axles", 1) > 0

vehicles_details_check.name: vehicles_details_check
vehicles_details_check.value:
coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_hp", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."cylinders", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."length_mm", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."width_mm", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."height_mm", 1) > 0 and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."tyres", 1) > 0
                        and coalesce("vehicles"."vehicles"."net_weight_kg", 1) > 0 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."made_in"), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."tyre_size"), 1) between 1 and 20

vehicles_migration_check.name: vehicles_migration_check
vehicles_migration_check.value:
("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."paper_reference" is null)
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."paper_reference"), 1) between 1 and 60
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" is distinct from 'back_capture'
                             or ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_case_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_by" is not null
                                 and "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_at" is not null))
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" is distinct from 'import'
                             or ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_row_id" is not null and "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_by" is not null))
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_row_id" is null or "vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_source" = 'import')
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_row_id" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_id" is null)
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_id" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_name" is null)
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_import_name"), 1) between 1 and 200
                        and ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_by" is null) = ("vehicles"."vehicles"."migration_verified_at" is null)

vehicles_text_check.name: vehicles_text_check
vehicles_text_check.value:
length("vehicles"."vehicles"."make") between 1 and 60 and length("vehicles"."vehicles"."model") between 1 and 60
                        and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."engine_number"), 1) between 1 and 30 and coalesce(length("vehicles"."vehicles"."colour"), 1) between 1 and 30
